'''XoXaan's Temple,''' also known as the '''Sith Temple''' on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], was an [[Sith temple/Legends|edifice]] employed by the [[One Sith]] as of [[137 ABY]]. It was to this temple that former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]] was summoned by the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of [[XoXaan]], and subsequently trained in the ways of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Later, after Hett assumed the mantle of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and created his [[One Sith]] [[Sith Order|Order]], he had the temple restored to habitable conditions.

When Krayt was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]] following the [[Battle on Had Abbadon]], his remains were brought to the temple by Wyyrlok and placed on display in a specialized [[Stasis Room|stasis chamber]]. The temple also contained [[Healing Chambers|healing chambers]], which housed [[Darth/Legends|Darths]] [[Darth Stryfe|Stryfe]], [[Darth Talon|Talon]], and [[Darth Maladi|Maladi]], who had all suffered grievous injuries during that same battle on [[Had Abbadon]]. To maintain control of the Order, Darth Wyyrlok placed Krayt's body in the Temple's [[Stasis Room]] so that other Sith would believe that Krayt still lived, allowing Wyyrlok to act as Krayt's [[Voice]] and [[Regent/Legends|Regent]] while secretly controlling both the Order and the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith Empire]].
